blocks.text: Jeremiah 50 belongs, in the customary Masoretic arrangement, to the collection of pronouncements concerning nations in chapters 46–51. The book of Jeremiah brings together many forms of material—poetry, prose sermons, narratives, letters, headings, restoration material, and these nation-focused pronouncements—and its formation and arrangement remain debated. An ancient Greek edition is substantially shorter and places the nation oracles earlier and in a different order. This chapter’s placement therefore reflects one received arrangement of a book with a complex textual history.
